_comment: The academic matrix: two benchmarks, four agents, two models.
Terminal-Bench 2.x is executed by harbor (its official harness), so the
suite carries options.harness='harbor'; set it to 'tb' for the 1.x
'terminal-bench-core' datasets, which use the tb CLI instead.
Models: `h200-ornith` is served locally with vLLM (see
`python -m benchmarks models`), `anthropic-sonnet` is the hosted baseline.
A containerised agent must be able to route to the local endpoint, so bind
vLLM to 0.0.0.0 and use a LAN address rather than 127.0.0.1.
SWE-bench pins by HuggingFace revision (set `version` once you have looked
it up); every run records the resolved revision in manifest.json.

models.name: h200-ornith
models.notes: served by vLLM on the H200 (bash scripts/bench_vllm.sh or `python -m benchmarks models`)

models.name: anthropic-sonnet
models.notes: needs the key in the environment; nothing else in this config does

agents.name: mock
agents._comment: no model needed; run this first to check the plumbing
